'''Tanglang''' ({{lang-zh|堂郎语}}), or '''Tholo''' (autonym: ''{{IPA|tʰo55 lo33 zɑ33}}''), is a [[Loloish language]] spoken by 947 people in 8 villages of southern Tai'an Township 太安乡, [[Lijiang, Yunnan|Lijiang County]], [[Yunnan]], including in Hongmai 红麦<ref>{{Cite web |title=Yùlóng nàxīzú zìzhìxiàn tàiān xiāng hóngmài cūn wěihuì > cūn qíng gàikuàng |script-title=zh:玉龙纳西族自治县太安乡红麦村委会 > 村情概况 |trans-title=Hongmai Village Committee, Tai'an Township, Yulong Naxi Autonomous County > Village Situation |url=http://www.ynszxc.gov.cn/villagePage/vIndex.aspx?departmentid=237017 |url-status=dead |website=ynszxc.gov.cn |access-date=2016-04-12 |archive-date=2018-09-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927212239/http://www.ynszxc.gov.cn/villagePage/vIndex.aspx?departmentid=237017 }}</ref><ref name="Bradley 2004">{{Cite conference |last=Bradley |first=David |date=2004 |title=Endangered Central Ngwi Languages of Central Yunnan |url=https://www.academia.edu/5737342 |conference=37th International Conference on Sino-Tibetan Languages and Linguistics, Lund University, Sweden |type=Keynote Presentation |language=en |access-date=2016-04-16 |archive-date=2021-08-11 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210811152131/https://www.academia.edu/5737342 |url-status=live }}</ref> and Shuijing 水井村<ref name="Gai 2002" /> villages. Tanglang has been in long-term contact with [[Bai language|Bai]], and is also in contact with [[Naxi language|Naxi]].<ref name="Bradley 2004" /> The speakers' name for the language is ''{{IPA|tʰo42 lo42}}''.<ref name="Bradley 2004" />

==Names==
Tanglang speakers are referred to by the following names.<ref name="Gai 2002">{{Cite journal |last=Gai |first=Xingzhi 盖兴之 |date=2002 |title=Tánglánghuà gàikuàng |script-title=zh:堂郎话概况 |trans-title=Tanglang Dialect Overview |journal=Minzu yuwen |language=zh |volume=2002 |issue=3 |script-journal=zh:民族語文}}</ref>
*autonym: ''tʰo42 lo42 zɑ33'' (Tulusha 吐鲁沙)
*exonym in [[Heqing County]]: Tanglangzi 堂郎子
*exonym of the Nalu 那鲁 (Heihua 黑话) people: Moxie 麽些
*exonym in [[Jianchuan County]] 剑川县: ''tʰo31 lo31 χo33''
*exonym in [[Lijiang]]ba District 丽江县坝区: ''tʰo33 le33 dʌ31''
*exonym in Nanshan 南山: ''lu55 lu33''
